newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Thinly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Thinly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus no trades Tuesday. Bids and offers included:
- One barge, Illinois River, next week, bid 130 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi, week of March 30, bid 145 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, St Louis, Mississippi, week of March 30, no bid, offer 115 percent.
- Eight barges, upper Mississippi (St. Paul through Savage), two each week April, bid 170 percent, offer 200 percent.
